MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.18: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
Examples: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe-samples-web
Hand model: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task
Transformers.js 2.17.2: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
CLIP model: https://huggingface.co/Xenova/clip-vit-base-patch32
ONNX Runtime Web 1.14.0: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
exifr 7.1.3: https://github.com/MikeKovarik/exifr
All runtime assets are served locally. Portrait test image is from the official Transformers.js documentation dataset and is not bundled in the website.
